Name: Kamen Rider Weapons
Author: SGEzlo
Description:
This mod adds weapons from the hit TV series from Japan, Kamen Rider. Currently a work in progress. You can find these weapon in the Adventurer's Guild but they're fairly end level weapons that are really expensive.

How to Install:
1. Download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400] SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url].
2. Unzip the contents of the zip file into your Mod folder.
3. You're now ready!
